anchoredEdits.content: - `venue-rescue-synthesis`: venue-rescue-synthesis runs cheap text research and a vision-based brand audit, then a specialist financial narrative, then a strong synthesis-and-critique that fuses everything into a rescue strategy with wild and practical options, then a design phase that builds a stylish interactive investor site, then an independent verification.
